author: reek
body: Smoke test for Raspberry Pi 4 board drivers. MMIO stubs return 0 on the hosted VM, so this exercises the driver logic and bit manipulation without real hardware.

author: reek
body: The driver functions declare [Device.Mmio], so this test declares it too. It cannot not: a test chapter is not on the effect-exemption list, which means the row the drivers carry is checked right here, at the first caller outside the quire. Each test returns 1 when its driver calls all complete; the six sum to the expected 6.

author: reek
body: The delay is pure -- it spins on the CPU and touches nothing -- so it is bound with a plain let, not an act-bind. If someone gives it a register access later, this line stops compiling.
